facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1956; a visitor account describes footings and lookout debris at the site, with no date given for the visit

visit.trail_note: About 2.5 miles, roughly 1,000 feet of climb, from a gated road off road No. 1152; the writer said it was unknown whether a trail exists

notes_for_editor: Register, firelookout.com and the visitor account agree on a 1935 build and 1956 abandonment. The visitor account is undated and is the only source on the site's remains; it may be old. No source found on public access, so no access level is recorded; the register places the site in national forest land. Visitor account cites a 1983 Metsker map showing a trail, not used. Visitor account also says the tower's height is unknown; no height recorded.
